newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia MCL director sells 3.9 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia MCL director sells 3.9 mln shrs.

text.p: Apparel manufacturer MCL Corporation Bhd announced on Friday the disposal of 3.9 million shares in the company, belonging to managing director Tang Yeam Soon, for a total of 40.95 million ringgit.
The consideration translates to 10.50 ringgit per share.
The statement did not say who bought the shares.
According to MCL's annual report for the year ended March 31, 1996, Tang Yeam Soon owned a total of 10.26 million shares in MCL before the disposal.
Officials from the company could not be reached for further comment.
